text_en: In those days Mattathias son of John son of Simeon, a priest of the family of Joarib, moved from Jerusalem and settled in Modein.
text_cn: 那时，若望的儿子，西默盎的孙子，属于约阿黎布家的司祭玛塔提雅起来，离开耶路撒冷，迁居摩丁。

text_en: He had five sons, John surnamed Gaddi,
text_cn: 他有五个儿子：即若望，又名加狄；

text_en: Simon called Thassi,
text_cn: 息孟，又名塔息；

text_en: Judas called Maccabeus,
text_cn: 犹大又名玛加伯；

text_en: Eleazar called Avaran, and Jonathan called Apphus.
text_cn: 厄肋阿匝尔，又名奥郎；约纳堂，又名阿弗斯。

text_en: He saw the blasphemies being committed in Judah and Jerusalem,
text_cn: 他看见在犹太和耶路撒冷发生的亵圣的事，

text_en: and said, “Alas! Why was I born to see this, the ruin of my people, the ruin of the holy city, and to live there when it was given over to the enemy, the sanctuary given over to aliens?
text_cn: 便说：“可怜的我呀！难道我生在世上，是为看着我的民族沦亡，圣城被践踏，当圣城落在敌人手中，圣殿落在外人手中时，而袖手旁观吗？

text_en: Her temple has become like a person without honor;
text_cn: 圣殿好似成了一个被轻贱的人。

text_en: her glorious vessels have been carried into exile. Her infants have been killed in her streets, her youths by the sword of the foe.
text_cn: 光荣的器皿被抢掠劫夺，婴儿在街市上被屠杀，青年丧身敌人刀下！

text_en: What nation has not inherited her palaces and has not seized her spoils?
text_cn: 那一个民族没有占领过这国土，没有来劫掠分赃？

text_en: All her adornment has been taken away; no longer free, she has become a slave.
text_cn: 城内一切点缀全被洗劫净尽，昔日的自由城，今日为人所奴役。

text_en: And see, our holy place, our beauty, and our glory have been laid waste; the Gentiles have profaned them.
text_cn: 我们的圣所，我们的华丽，我们的光荣，都成了一片荒凉，受外族人的污辱！

text_en: Why should we live any longer? ”
text_cn: 我们还活着作什么？”

text_en: Then Mattathias and his sons tore their clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourned greatly.
text_cn: 于是玛塔提雅和他的儿子都撕破了衣裳，穿上苦衣，悲哀非常。

text_en: The king’s officers who were enforcing the apostasy came to the town of Modein to make them offer sacrifice.
text_cn: 君王派来强迫人民背教的官吏，也来到了摩丁城，勒令人祭神。

text_en: Many from Israel came to them; and Mattathias and his sons were assembled.
text_cn: 有些以色列人附和了，但玛塔提雅和他的儿子却一致反抗；

text_en: Then the king’s officers spoke to Mattathias as follows: “You are a leader, honored and great in this town, and supported by sons and brothers.
text_cn: 君王的官吏对玛塔提雅说：“你是这城的首领，有面子又有势力，还受儿子兄弟们的拥护。

text_en: Now be the first to come and do what the king commands, as all the Gentiles and the people of Judah and those that are left in Jerusalem have done. Then you and your sons will be numbered among the Friends of the king, and you and your sons will be honored with silver and gold and many gifts. ”
text_cn: 如今，请你首先前来遵行王的谕令，如同各国的人、犹太居民以及留在耶路撒冷的人所作的一般；这样，你和你的儿子就算是君王的朋友，你和你的儿子可以荣获金银和各种恩赐。”

text_en: But Mattathias answered and said in a loud voice: “Even if all the nations that live under the rule of the king obey him, and have chosen to obey his commandments, every one of them abandoning the religion of their ancestors,
text_cn: 玛塔提雅高声回答说：“即便所有君王国土中的人民都听从他，背弃了自己祖先的教礼，服从王的命令，

text_en: I and my sons and my brothers will continue to live by the covenant of our ancestors.
text_cn: 我和我的儿子以及我的弟兄，仍然照我们祖先的盟约去行，

text_en: Far be it from us to desert the law and the ordinances.
text_cn: 决不背弃法律和教规，

text_en: We will not obey the king’s words by turning aside from our religion to the right hand or to the left. ”
text_cn: 决不听从王的谕令，而背离我们的教规，或偏左或偏右。”

text_en: When he had finished speaking these words, a Jew came forward in the sight of all to offer sacrifice on the altar in Modein, according to the king’s command.
text_cn: 他刚说完了这些话，正有一个犹太人前来，当众在摩丁的祭坛上祭神，全照王的谕令。

text_en: When Mattathias saw it, he burned with zeal and his heart was stirred. He gave vent to righteous anger; he ran and killed him on the altar.
text_cn: 玛塔提雅一见，热情勃发，五内俱焚，要照法律发泄义怒，于是冲上前去，把那人杀死在祭坛上。

text_en: At the same time he killed the king’s officer who was forcing them to sacrifice, and he tore down the altar.
text_cn: 同时也把迫令人民献祭的王吏杀了，并把祭坛拆毁。

text_en: Thus he burned with zeal for the law, just as Phinehas did against Zimri son of Salu.
text_cn: 他对于法律这样热诚，完全像丕乃哈斯对撒路的儿子齐默黎所作的一样。

text_en: Then Mattathias cried out in the town with a loud voice, saying: “Let every one who is zealous for the law and supports the covenant come out with me! ”
text_cn: 于是玛塔提雅在城内高声喊说：“凡热心法律，拥护盟约的，请跟我来！”

text_en: Then he and his sons fled to the hills and left all that they had in the town.
text_cn: 接着，他和他的儿子，把所有的家产都留在城里，逃到山中去了。

text_en: At that time many who were seeking righteousness and justice went down to the wilderness to live there,
text_cn: 那时，有许多拥护正义正道的人，也都逃到旷野里去居住，

text_en: they, their sons, their wives, and their livestock, because troubles pressed heavily upon them.
text_cn: 将子女妻室牲畜也一同带了去，因为大难已临头上。

text_en: And it was reported to the king’s officers, and to the troops in Jerusalem the city of David, that those who had rejected the king’s command had gone down to the hiding places in the wilderness.
text_cn: 其时有人报告王吏及驻扎耶路撒冷达味城的军队说：“背叛谕令的那些人，都隐藏到旷野山洞里去了。”

text_en: Many pursued them, and overtook them; they encamped opposite them and prepared for battle against them on the sabbath day.
text_cn: 于是大队人马前去追捕，到了那里，摆好阵势，在安息日那天向他们宣战，

text_en: They said to them, “Enough of this! Come out and do what the king commands, and you will live. ”
text_cn: 说：“到现在为止，若你们出来遵从王命，还可以活命。”

text_en: But they said, “We will not come out, nor will we do what the king commands and so profane the sabbath day. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“我们不出去，也不遵从王命，亵渎安息日！”

text_en: Then the enemy quickly attacked them.
text_cn: 敌军立即攻击他们。

text_en: But they did not answer them or hurl a stone at them or block up their hiding places,
text_cn: 但他们不向敌人还击，也不抛石，也不堵塞藏身之处，

text_en: for they said, “Let us all die in our innocence; heaven and earth testify for us that you are killing us unjustly. ”
text_cn: 只说：“我们众人情愿无辜而死！有天地为我们作证：你们杀害我们，极不公平。”

text_en: So they attacked them on the sabbath, and they died, with their wives and children and livestock, to the number of a thousand persons.
text_cn: 王军于是在安息日那天攻击了他们，他们和他们的妇孺牲畜都被屠杀了，人数约有一千。

text_en: When Mattathias and his friends learned of it, they mourned for them deeply.
text_cn: 玛塔提雅和他的朋友一听说此事，都十分悲痛。

text_en: And all said to their neighbors: “If we all do as our kindred have done and refuse to fight with the Gentiles for our lives and for our ordinances, they will quickly destroy us from the earth. ”
text_cn: 彼此商议说：“若大家都像我们的弟兄所行的一样，为保护自己的性命和教规，不还击外邦人，那么，人很快就要把我们从地面上消灭了。”

text_en: So they made this decision that day: “Let us fight against anyone who comes to attack us on the sabbath day; let us not all die as our kindred died in their hiding places. ”
text_cn: 于是在那天大家决定：“即便人在安息日来击我们，我们也应还击抵抗，免得我们像我们的弟兄都死在洞中。”

text_en: Then there united with them a company of Hasideans, mighty warriors of Israel, all who offered themselves willingly for the law.
text_cn: 当时，哈息待党派的人也与他们会合；这些人都是以色列的勇士，甘心为法律舍生的人。

text_en: And all who became fugitives to escape their troubles joined them and reinforced them.
text_cn: 还有逃难流亡的人都同他们联合，支持他们。

text_en: They organized an army, and struck down sinners in their anger and renegades in their wrath; the survivors fled to the Gentiles for safety.
text_cn: 于是他们便组成军队，发奋攻打罪人，怒袭叛徒；其余的人都逃往外邦人那里，为求安全。

text_en: And Mattathias and his friends went around and tore down the altars;
text_cn: 玛塔提雅和他的朋友便到处巡行，拆毁祭坛，

text_en: they forcibly circumcised all the uncircumcised boys that they found within the borders of Israel.
text_cn: 凡在以色列境内遇见未受割损的孩子，便强迫他们割损；

text_en: They hunted down the arrogant, and the work prospered in their hands.
text_cn: 此外，还扫荡了暴徒，在历次战役中都很顺利。

text_en: They rescued the law out of the hands of the Gentiles and kings, and they never let the sinner gain the upper hand.
text_cn: 如此，保障了法律，摆脱了外邦人及国王的控制，不让恶人得势。

text_en: Now the days drew near for Mattathias to die, and he said to his sons: “Arrogance and scorn have now become strong; it is a time of ruin and furious anger.
text_cn: 玛塔提雅临死时，对他的儿子们说：“现在是傲慢暴横得势，也是灾难和仇恨的时候。

text_en: Now, my children, show zeal for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of our ancestors.
text_cn: 孩子们！现今你们对法律应热诚服膺（yīng），应为我们祖先的盟约舍生致命，

text_en: “Remember the deeds of the ancestors, which they did in their generations; and you will receive great honor and an everlasting name.
text_cn: 要怀念祖先当日所创的大业，这样才可获得无上的光荣和不朽的芳名。

text_en: Was not Abraham found faithful when tested, and it was reckoned to him as righteousness?
text_cn: 亚巴郎不是在受试探中显示了忠信，才算他有义德吗？

text_en: Joseph in the time of his distress kept the commandment, and became lord of Egypt.
text_cn: 若瑟在患难中遵守了诫命，然后才作了埃及的主人。

text_en: Phinehas our ancestor, because he was deeply zealous, received the covenant of everlasting priesthood.
text_cn: 我们的祖先丕乃哈斯因为热诚，才获永为司祭的盟约。

text_en: Joshua, because he fulfilled the command, became a judge in Israel.
text_cn: 若苏厄因满全了天主的命，才作了以色列的民长。

text_en: Caleb, because he testified in the assembly, received an inheritance in the land.
text_cn: 加肋布因在会众前作证，才在此地获得了产业。

text_en: David, because he was merciful, inherited the throne of the kingdom forever.
text_cn: 达味因慈悲为怀，才承受了永世的王位。

text_en: Elijah, because of great zeal for the law, was taken up into heaven.
text_cn: 厄里亚因热爱法律，才被接升天。

text_en: Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael believed and were saved from the flame.
text_cn: 哈纳尼雅、阿匝黎雅、米沙耳因着信赖，才得拯救，免受火烧。

text_en: Daniel, because of his innocence, was delivered from the mouth of the lions.
text_cn: 达尼尔因心中纯洁，才蒙拯救，免于狮子的口。

text_en: “And so observe, from generation to generation, that none of those who put their trust in him will lack strength.
text_cn: 你们要世世代代这样存想：凡是仰望他的，决一无所缺。

text_en: Do not fear the words of sinners, for their splendor will turn into dung and worms.
text_cn: 不要怕恶人的议论，因为他们的光荣要变成粪土蛆虫，

text_en: Today they will be exalted, but tomorrow they will not be found, because they will have returned to the dust, and their plans will have perished.
text_cn: 今日飞黄腾达，明日即为黄花；人一归于灰土，他的计谋也云消雾散。

text_en: My children, be courageous and grow strong in the law, for by it you will gain honor.
text_cn: 孩子们！你们要刚强不屈，遵守法律，法律必使你们蒙受光荣。

text_en: “Here is your brother Simeon who, I know, is wise in counsel; always listen to him; he shall be your father.
text_cn: 你们的兄弟息孟，我晓得他是具有超见的人，你们该常听从他，他该接你们父亲之位。

text_en: Judas Maccabeus has been a mighty warrior from his youth; he shall command the army for you and fight the battle against the peoples.
text_cn: 犹大玛加伯自幼奋勇，他该是你们的将领，作战攻打异族。

text_en: You shall rally around you all who observe the law, and avenge the wrong done to your people.
text_cn: 你们应召集所有遵行法律的人来跟随你们，为百姓复仇雪恨。

text_en: Pay back the Gentiles in full, and obey the commands of the law. ”
text_cn: 应反抗异族，应坚守法律的规条。”

text_en: Then he blessed them, and was gathered to his ancestors.
text_cn: 他祝福了他们以后，就归到他亲族那里去了。

text_en: He died in the one hundred forty-sixth year and was buried in the tomb of his ancestors at Modein. And all Israel mourned for him with great lamentation.
text_cn: 死于一四六年， 他的儿子们把他葬在摩丁的祖茔（yíng）里，全以色列为他举丧志哀。
